name: phage-explorer
description: Terminal UI for browsing, visualizing, and analyzing bacteriophage genetic data with color-coded sequences and 3D ASCII models.

scripts.build:db:annotated: bun run build:db && bun run build:esm2 && bun run build:pfam && bun run scripts/build-web-db.ts --source phage.db --output packages/web/public
scripts.build:all: bun run build:mac-arm64 && bun run build:mac-x64 && bun run build:linux-x64 && bun run build:linux-arm64 && bun run build:windows-x64
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: bun test packages/core packages/comparison packages/db-runtime packages/db-schema packages/renderer-3d packages/state packages/data-pipeline packages/tui packages/web/src
scripts.test:integration: PHAGE_INTEGRATION=1 bun test --test-name-pattern integration packages/core packages/comparison packages/db-runtime packages/db-schema packages/renderer-3d packages/state packages/data-pipeline packages/tui packages/web/src
